judgments.note: The only document is a consolidated decision for 12-1-10 Vtec and 143-9-10 Vtec; 143-9-10 Vtec is the appeal of the District 4 Environmental Commission's refusal to reconsider its Act 250 Rule 34(E) ruling. Act 250 appeals are not municipal appeals under the guide, so the case is excluded.
The appealed body is the District 4 Environmental Commission acting under Act 250; no municipal board or officer decision is challenged.
